newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bundesbank sets 14-day tender at fixed 3.00 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bundesbank sets 14-day tender at fixed 3.00 pct.

text.p: The Bundesbank said on Tuesday it had set a 14-day tender at a fixed rate of 3.00 percent.
Funds will be credited to accounts tomorrow and the securities have to be repurchased on March 12.
A 74.9 billion mark facility set at a fixed rate of three percent expires on Wednesday.
A 14-day facility set last week at a fixed 3.00 percent had an allotment of 72.9 billion marks.
The repo rate, the Bundesbank's main money market rate, has been fixed at 3.00 percent since August.
